data.summary:
I aspire to excel as a SAP EWM Digital Supply Chain Consultant, leveraging my expertise to tackle challenges and streamline operations across various projects. With a knack for problem-solving, adept multitasking, I am poised to deliver impactful results and drive organizational success.
I possess over 3.4 years of comprehensive experience in Supply Chain Management (SCM), with a specific focus on SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), where I have worked on one end to end implementation, Testing and Support Project.

all_skills: Proficient in SAP EWM Functional Knowledge.
 Skilled in using various Microsoft Office tools.
 Possess strong organizational abilities and work well within a team.
 Effective communicator with a talent for building relationships.
 Willing to relocate and undertake onsite travel when necessary.

Objective: I aspire to excel as a SAP EWM Digital Supply Chain Consultant, leveraging my expertise to tackle challenges and streamline operations across various projects. With a knack for problem-solving, adept multitasking, I am poised to deliver impactful results and drive organizational success.
Professional Summary: I possess over 3.4 years of comprehensive experience in Supply Chain Management (SCM), with a specific focus on SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), where I have worked on one end to end implementation, Testing and Support Project.
raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience:
Capgemini (February 2022 – May 2025)  Designation:  Experience: SAP EWM Consultant 3.4 years 
Client: VPK Group (March 2024- May 2025) Project: Implementation
Handled Internal Processes and Physical Inventory.  Actively participated in System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).  Created user manuals and conducted end-user training sessions.  Post-implementation support.  Experienced in End-to-End integration setup between ECC and EWM for transferring master data and transactional data
Experienced in defining storage area, storage bins and managing them.  Configuration and assignment of activity area  Maintained warehouse product in EWM  Worked on simple warehouse process like Deconsolidation, VAS, Packing specification,& inbound and outbound process
Work with senior team members to identify and manage risks.  Configuration of organization structure of warehouse  Prepared test scripts for testing the configured scenarios such as master data, documents
Client: Gefco Project: Testing(April 2023-March 2024)
Conducted end-to-end functional testing, ensuring warehouse processes such as inbound, outbound, and internal movements functioned according to business requirements. Involved in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for SAP EWM to validate business process alignment and system functionality from the end-user perspective.

Given training to end users to enhance user familiarity and confidence with the system..  Prepared detailed documents, including test scenarios, test cases, and expected outcomes based on business requirements.
Client: Gefco Project: Support (February 2022-March 2023)
Resolved P3 and P4 support tickets by diagnosing issues, participated with senior engineers to address P1 and P2 tickets ensuring timely resolution according to SLA guidelines.
Utilized ServiceNow to track and resolve issues, ensuring detailed documentation and timely closure in line with ITIL standards.
 Worked on change requests, implementing configuration and process updates to support evolving
business requirements.
SAP Knowledge (Functional): Core SAP Module Skills in SAP EWM and basic knowledge of SAP MM
SAP S4 HANA and EWM integration.  EWM warehouse organization elements and master data – SCU, storage types, storage sections, storage bins, activity area, staging area, warehouse door and work centers.
Configuring Availability Groups & Stock Types.  Handling Unit management – Packaging specifications. Good knowledge on In-bound cycle with packing using packaging specification.
Physical Inventory.  Familiar with Warehouse order creation rules (WOCR).  Good knowledge in Wave Management.  Warehouse process type and related configuration.  Storage control – hands on POSC, LOSC, and Wave Management etc.   Able to monitor stock movement, execute stock placement and removal using put away and picking strategies.
Aware extending the Master data through CIF from ECC to EWM.  Good Knowledge on RFUI Persona.  Aware of Lighthouse application.
